original_prompt:
Build "Document Vault" — an internal admin tool for digitising and searching paper/PDF records.

One user role: Admin.

One entity — Document:

file (file upload)
original_filename (text)
uploaded_at (timestamp)
status (queued | processing | complete | failed)
ocr_text (text, searchable)
extracted_fields (jsonb — key/value pairs from AI extraction)
confidence (numeric 0-1)
error_message (text)
org_id
One workflow — ProcessDocument (dispatched per file on upload):

ocr_document (PaddleOCR sidecar) → writes text + confidence
ai_extract with fields [customer_name, account_number, amount, date, reference_number] → writes each key/value into extracted_fields
db_update Document → ocr_text, extracted_fields, confidence, status=complete, processed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
On failure → status=failed, error_message=<reason>
Three pages:

/upload (landing) — Multi-file dropzone + Upload button. Dispatches ProcessDocument once per file. On submit, navigates to /documents.
/documents — Table of all documents, newest first. Columns: filename, uploaded_at, status (coloured Tag), extracted-field count. Auto-refresh every 5s while any row is processing. Row click → /documents/{id}.
/documents/{id} — Two-column viewer. Left: original file inline (PDF/image preview). Right: extracted fields as a DescriptionList (key → value with confidence chip). Collapsed panel below: full ocr_text.
/search — Single SearchInput. Full-text search across ocr_text + all values in extracted_fields. Results show filename, matched snippet, and any customer_name / account_number in the result.
Nav: Upload, Documents, Search.

Seed: ~10 documents across mixed statuses (at least one still processing so the auto-refresh is visible), ~5 with customer_name="Acme Corp" and account_number containing "4477" so /search returns hits out of the box.

Not building: batches, per-batch rollup, multiple roles, edit-extracted-field workflow, retention policies, tenant portal.
